Name: Pink Lolita Interface
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
an interface mod to satisfy any pink lover's need for all things cute and pink ♡ ୨୧

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
1. download and install content patcher
2. download this mod
3. unzip contents into stardew's mod folder

[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ there are two versions of this mod to choose from: normal ver. and pastel pink ver.
♡ i would strongly recommend using the Custom Menu Background mod alongside this one in order to make the title screen background all pink and pretty like in the main picture~ found here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7416
♡ alex in the picture is from this mod: ﻿https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11321
